description: Twelve supplied development questions plus independently worded validation/scope checks. References were checked against the saved official corpus; they are never indexed.

cases.question: What is tuition cost for the program?
cases.reference_answer: The saved Summer 2026 through Spring 2027 page lists $6,830 per course, $81,960 for 12 courses and $122,940 for 18 courses, plus additional costs. State the period; do not present these as a guaranteed Autumn 2027 rate.

cases.question: What scholarships are available for the program?
cases.reference_answer: The Data Science Institute Scholarship and MS in Applied Data Science Alumni Scholarship provide partial tuition support. No separate application is required; applying early is recommended.

cases.question: What are the minimum scores for the TOEFL and IELTS English Language Requirement?
cases.reference_answer: The current saved program page lists TOEFL 5 as the current requirement, TOEFL 102 as the prior requirement, and IELTS 7, with no subscore requirement. The supplied sample only mentioned the prior TOEFL score.

cases.question: Is there an application fee waiver?
cases.reference_answer: Refer to the Physical Sciences Division fee waiver policy. The program page lists a $90 non-refundable application fee. Do not promise a waiver.

cases.question: What are the deadlines for the in-person program?
cases.reference_answer: The saved Autumn 2027 cycle lists Nov 9 2026, Dec 7 2026, Jan 26 2027 (visa sponsorship), Mar 4 2027, May 6 2027, and Jun 23 2027. State the cycle and distinguish online deadlines.

cases.question: How long will it take for me to receive a decision on my application?
cases.reference_answer: Admissions decisions are typically released 1-2 months after each deadline, and only complete applications are reviewed. The saved FAQ does not establish the sample's older blanket claim about online rolling decisions.

cases.question: Can I set up an advising appointment with the enrollment management team?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Use the Schedule an Appointment links on How to Apply; the saved page has different counselor and Online/In-Person scheduling links. Provide a retrieved link rather than inventing one.

cases.question: Where can I mail my official transcripts?
cases.reference_answer: The University of Chicago, Attention: MS in Applied Data Science Admissions, 455 N Cityfront Plaza Dr., Suite 2800, Chicago IL 60611. E-transcripts can be sent directly by the institution to applieddatascience-admissions@uchicago.edu. Only unofficial uploads are needed when applying. The supplied Suite 950 sample is outdated.

cases.question: Does the Master's in Applied Data Science Online program provide visa sponsorship?
cases.reference_answer: No. The online program does not provide visa sponsorship. Only eligible full-time in-person programs provide visa sponsorship.

cases.question: How do I apply to the MBA/MS program?
cases.reference_answer: Apply through Booth's centralized joint application process. Complete the Chicago Booth Full-Time MBA application and select MBA/MS in Applied Data Science as the program of interest.

cases.question: Is the MS in Applied Data Science program STEM/OPT eligible?
cases.reference_answer: The full-time in-person MS-ADS is STEM-designated for eligible students to apply for the STEM OPT extension. Approval is at USCIS discretion; it is not a guarantee.

cases.question: How many courses must you complete to earn UChicago's Master's in Applied Data Science?
cases.reference_answer: The standard path is 12 courses: 6 core, 4 electives and 2 capstone courses, plus the required noncredit Career Seminar (waivers may apply). The in-person thesis track is 18 courses, so clarify the pathway.

cases.question: I was admitted. Which street address should my college use to post the sealed academic records?
cases.reference_answer: Use 455 N Cityfront Plaza Dr., Suite 2800, Chicago IL 60611, attention MS in Applied Data Science Admissions. Documents should arrive in a school-sealed envelope.

cases.question: Is there a longer thesis pathway, and is it available to online students?
cases.reference_answer: The 2-year thesis track is an 18-course, 21-month option for a limited number of full-time in-person students. It is not available online or part-time.

cases.question: Do I need to submit a second application for merit funding?
cases.reference_answer: The listed partial tuition scholarships do not require a separate application; applying early is recommended.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.reference_answer: Decline to answer an unrelated geography question and offer help with the MS-ADS program.
